items.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash (via Google Vids)
items.why: 該模型於 8 月正式發佈，並於 9 月 23 日/24 日透過 Google Vids 向所有 Google/Workspace 用戶免費開放，大幅提升了可及性和影響力，並在 Artificial Analysis 影片排行榜上名列前茅。
items.why_en: The model was GA in August, with free access and expanded controls rolled out to all Google/Workspace users via Google Vids on Sept 23/24, significantly boosting accessibility and impact, and ranking highly on Artificial Analysis video leaderboards.

items.name: WAN 3.0
items.why: 於 8 月 24 日正式發佈，支援長達 30 秒的影片生成、原生音訊和多模態輸入（包括文件），非常適合敘事和動畫內容。
items.why_en: Officially released broadly on August 24, it supports up to 30-second video generation, native audio, and multimodal inputs (including documents), making it highly suitable for narrative and animated content.

items.name: Dreamina Seedance 2.5
items.why: 作為 Seedance 2.0 的直接升級版，於 7 月 31 日發佈，提供長達 30 秒的音訊影片生成和更廣泛的參考工作流程，對於風格化內容的提示遵循和一致性至關重要。
items.why_en: A direct upgrade to Seedance 2.0, released on July 31, offering up to 30-second audio-video generation and broader reference workflows, crucial for prompt adherence and consistency in stylized content.

items.name: MiniMax H3
items.why: 於 8 月 3 日開放權重，以其富有表現力的角色動作和高性價比而聞名，對於客製化動畫專案具有吸引力。
items.why_en: With open weights released on August 3, it is known for expressive character motion and strong value, making it appealing for custom animation projects.

items.name: LTX-2.5
items.why: 於 8 月 11 日提供支援，是開放權重領域中排名最高的模型，也是唯一支援原生音訊的開放模型，為需要靈活性的動畫工作流程提供了重要選擇。
items.why_en: With support available on August 11, it is the highest-ranked open-weight model with native audio, offering a significant option for animation workflows requiring flexibility.

items.name: Sora

items.name: Gemini 3.8 Live

items.why_en: Brings near real-time visual presence to conversational AI for enterprises, with precise lip-syncing, natural expressions, and fluid turn-taking.

overall.why_en: Highest surface realism; quad mesh + 3D inpainting

items.name: Tripo P2.0
items.why: 首創原生四邊形網格生成，提供高達 50,000 面三角形或 25,000 面四邊形拓撲，並新增網格編輯功能，大幅提升遊戲資產的生產就緒性與可控性。
items.why_en: Introduced native quad mesh generation, offering up to 50,000 faces for triangle topology and 25,000 faces for quad topology, with a new Mesh Edit feature, significantly enhancing production-readiness and control for game assets.

items.name: Meshy 7.1
items.why: 推出 Ultra 4K 模式，將幾何生成解析度提升至 4096³ 體素，原始網格可達 8,000 萬個三角形，大幅提升 3D 模型細節。
items.why_en: Launched Ultra 4K mode, boosting geometry generation resolution to 4096³ voxels with raw meshes up to 80 million triangles, significantly enhancing 3D model detail.

items.name: Hunyuan 3D 3.0
items.why: 作為主要版本升級，採用原生大模型架構，將幾何體與紋理生成解耦，提供高達 150 萬面高精度幾何體和 8K PBR 紋理，顯著提升模型品質。
items.why_en: As a major version upgrade, it features a native large model architecture that decouples geometry from texture generation, offering up to 1.5 million faces of high-precision geometry and 8K PBR textures, significantly improving model quality.

items.name: Hyper3D Rodin (Agentic Mode)
items.why: 整合 LLM 多模態上下文分析能力，實現自主理解、優化輸入並選擇建模路徑，將生成能力拓展至工業設計建模，提升複雜資產的精確性與可迭代性。
items.why_en: Integrates LLM multimodal context analysis for autonomous understanding, input optimization, and modeling path selection, extending generation capabilities to industrial design modeling, enhancing precision and iterability for complex assets.

items.name: GPT-6 Astra
items.why: 作為通用智慧模型，在 3D 內容創作方面展現突破性能力，能從多視角渲染圖重建 3D 物件並生成 CAD 代碼，並可直接整合至 Blender 和 Unreal Engine 5，實現自動化場景與資產生成。
items.why_en: As a general intelligence model, it demonstrates groundbreaking capabilities in 3D content creation, reconstructing 3D objects from multi-view renders by generating CAD code, and integrating directly with Blender and Unreal Engine 5 for automated scene and asset generation.

items.why_en: The open-source character rigging framework for Maya, mGear, updated to version 5.3, introducing Anim Picker 2.0, a significant rewrite of its animation picking tool.
